course_description: This course covers the basics of web development, from front-end technologies and server-side programming to deploying full-stack applications on modern cloud platforms.

learning_objectives: Identify the basic technologies of web development.
Describe the purpose of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
assessment_questions: What are the basic technologies of web development introduced in this module?
What is the role of HTML in web development?
What is the role of CSS in web development?
What is the role of JavaScript in web development?

modules.module_title: Server-Side Programming with Python and Flask
learning_objectives: Explain the concept of server-side programming.
Identify Python and Flask as tools for server-side development.
assessment_questions: Which language and framework are used for server-side programming in this module?

learning_objectives: Describe the use of modern cloud platforms for deployment.
assessment_questions: What is a full-stack web application?
What is used to deploy modern full-stack web applications?
